items.question: What is the standard rate of Value Added Tax (VAT) in the UAE?
items.gold: The rate of VAT is 5 per cent.
items.fact: UAE VAT standard rate is 5 per cent

items.question: What annual value of taxable supplies and imports makes VAT registration mandatory for a UAE-based business?
items.gold: A UAE-based business must register for VAT if its taxable supplies and imports exceed AED 375,000 per annum.
items.fact: Mandatory UAE VAT registration threshold is AED 375,000 annually
